en: Theragāthā 2.24 Dukanipāta, Tatiyavagga The Elder’s Verses 2.24 Second Book of Twos, Third Chapter I am one who has crossed over the flood; I have reached the further shore. Having seen the world as it truly is, I do not grieve for anything at all.
The Verses of the Elder Valliya:
“That which must be done by one of firm energy,
that which must be done by one who desires to awaken;”
Acting thus, I shall not fail;
And you, tell me the way.
Directly leading to the immersion in the Deathless;
through silence, I shall realize that which is attained through silence,
like the current of the Ganges reaching the ocean.
